usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all configured SMTP notification endpoints in the cluster, including their delivery settings, recipient lists, and enabled/disabled state. Requires either Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit privilege on /mapping/notifications. Note that passwords are not returned by this endpoint — only configuration metadata is exposed.

examples.summary: List all SMTP endpoints to review configured mail delivery targets

tips: The 'origin' field distinguishes user-created endpoints from Proxmox built-ins ('builtin') and built-ins that have been modified ('modified-builtin').
A disabled endpoint (disable: true) will appear in the list but silently drops notifications — check this field when troubleshooting missing alerts.
Default encryption mode is 'tls' (port 465); if your SMTP relay requires STARTTLS use 'starttls' (port 587).
Recipients can be specified as raw email addresses (mailto) or as PVE user IDs (mailto-user), which resolve to the user's configured email address.
